AXONIUS PLATFORM
Exposures
Built on the deepest asset, security, and business context in cybersecurity, Exposures unifies every finding, reveals what truly matters, and drives coordinated fixes from discovery to done.
Request a Demo
The world’s top companies rely on Axonius
Your scanners find problems. Axonius connects them to decisions.
Exposures consolidates vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, policy violations, and posture gaps from all of your security tools into one contextual view tied to the assets they impact. By layering security, business, and ownership context, it turns overwhelming findings into focused remediation that actually moves risk.
Unified security findings
One view, not twenty consoles
Aggregate, correlate, and deduplicate findings from scanners, CNAPP, identity tools, DAST, SAST, and more into a single place. Stop chasing the same issue across three tools because it showed up in all of them.
Triple-context prioritization
Right-size prioritization to your capacity
Combine technical severity with asset criticality, control state, and business impact. Surface the exposures that actually threaten the business — not just the ones with the highest CVSS score.
Automated owner verification
Know who fixes it before you file the ticket
Leverage the asset model to instantly map every finding to the person or team responsible. Eliminate the detective work and finger-pointing that stalls remediation for weeks.
Remediation orchestration
Close the loop on remediation efforts
Trigger automated fixes where safe, route ready-to-work tickets to Jira or ServiceNow, and track remediation against SLAs – all from one place. Accountability by design, not by persistence.
Ready to take action against all types of exposures?
Schedule a personalized demo with an Axonius specialist.
Contact Sales
Key Differentiators
Your scanners find thousands of problems. Correlate them against the full asset model and you'll know which ones actually matter.
The full risk picture, not 20 partial ones
Each tool sees its own slice. Axonius pulls findings from every source into one correlated view so the exposure picture is complete before any decision is made.
Risk context that matters
Technical severity alone misses the picture. Axonius layers business impact, ownership, control gaps, and asset relationships into every prioritization decision.
Remediation that moves by design
Bi-directional integrations trigger fixes and track tickets natively so remediation flows through systems teams already use, not a parallel workflow.
Beyond CVEs across all exposure types
Vulnerabilities are just one exposure type. Axonius covers misconfigurations, identity gaps, coverage failures, and SaaS risks across 40+ asset types.
